site.title: Mara & Terry
meta.description: Everything you need to know about Mara & Terry's wedding on 11 June 2027 at the Grohnder Fährhaus — the day's plan, how to get there, where to stay, and how to tell us you're coming.

weather.climate.summary: Around our date, Grohnde is usually about {high}°C by day and {low}°C overnight.
weather.climate.rain: It rains at some point on about {percent}% of days — worth packing for.

schedule.title: The day
schedule.intro: Roughly how the day will run. It is still a draft — we will firm the times up as we get closer, so check back nearer the date.
schedule.quietHourBody: A deliberate gap in the day. Little ones can nap, anyone who wants to change can change, and everyone gets a moment to catch their breath. It is not a lull — it is there so the evening lands well.
travel.title: Getting there
travel.intro: Grohnde is a small village on the river Weser, about an hour from Hannover. Here is how most people will get to us.
travel.stationBody: {name}, on the {line} line — about {km} km from the venue.
travel.verifyNote: Timetables for June 2027 have not been published yet, so please treat every journey time here as approximate and check again closer to the day.
travel.carpoolBody: Plenty of guests are driving the same roads. Tell us in your RSVP whether you have a spare seat or need one, and we will put people in touch.
stay.title: Where to stay
stay.intro: The easiest option by far is the venue itself — you can go straight upstairs at the end of the night. If it fills up, or you would rather be somewhere else, here are the options we have found within about 20 km.
stay.searchYourself: We are still tracking down a booking link for this one.
stay.listNote: We put this list together ourselves and have not stayed in any of them — please check reviews and prices before booking. Distances are approximate.
stay.thursdayBody: We will already be at the Fährhaus on the Thursday. If you are travelling far, arriving a night early turns a rushed morning into a relaxed one — and we would love the company.
dress.title: What to wear
dress.intro: Dress codes only really make sense next to each other, so here is the whole ladder — plus the few things about this particular venue that are worth knowing before you pack.
dress.anyCode: Any of these four is welcome — wear whatever you feel good in.
dress.anyCodeRules: Just two things we would ask: nothing like sweatpants or a hoodie, and nobody but the bride in a white dress.
dress.compareTitle: The usual codes, from relaxed to formal
dress.unsureBody: Dress as you would for a good dinner out and you will be exactly right. If you want to check, just message us — we genuinely do not mind.
faq.title: Questions
faq.intro: Things people have asked us. We will keep adding as the day gets closer, so it is worth a look before you write to us.
faq.askUsBody: Ask us. We will add it to this page so the next person who wonders finds it straight away.
photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Two albums: one we are filling now, and one that opens on the day.
photos.memories.title: Photos of us, from and with you
photos.memories.body: We are collecting pictures of us with the people we love, from long before the wedding. If you have one tucked away, please add it — we have plans for them on the day.
photos.party.title: Photos from the day
photos.party.body: On the wedding day this is where everything you take will go. One album, everybody's cameras, and nobody chasing people on WhatsApp a week later.
photos.party.waiting: We will open this album just before the wedding, and there will be QR codes on the tables.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: The short version: we collect what we need to feed you, seat you and find you a bed, we do not share it beyond that, and we delete it after the wedding.
rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.comingSoonBody: The form is nearly ready. We will send you a note as soon as it opens — there is nothing you need to do right now.
rsvp.intro: Please let us know by {deadline}. It takes about a minute, and you can change your answer afterwards.
rsvp.attendance.legend: Will you be able to join us?
rsvp.attendance.maybeSub: Tell us anyway and we'll check back
rsvp.contact.heading: First, how do we reach you?
rsvp.contact.intro: This is where your personal edit link goes, so do check it for typos.
rsvp.field.emailHint: We'll send your edit link here.
rsvp.field.expectedPartySize: Roughly how many of you would come?
rsvp.field.expectedPartySizeHint: A guess is fine — it just helps us plan.
rsvp.guests.heading: Who's coming?
rsvp.guests.intro: Add everyone in your group, including yourself. We'll use this for the seating and the catering.
rsvp.guests.max: More than {n}? Just message us and we'll add them.
rsvp.field.ageHint: How old they'll be on the day.
rsvp.stay.heading: Staying over?
rsvp.stay.intro: We'll already be at the Fährhaus on the Thursday. Join us for a relaxed evening before the wedding if you can.
rsvp.field.eveningParty: Will you stay for dinner and the party?
rsvp.field.hotelStatus: Would you like a room at the Grohnder Fährhaus?
rsvp.stay.note: We'll pass your details to the hotel and come back to you — nothing is booked yet.
rsvp.travel.heading: How will you get here?
rsvp.travel.intro: Grohnde is out in the countryside, so it helps us to know.
rsvp.field.carpoolConsent: Share my name and number with other guests
rsvp.field.carpoolConsentSub: Only with people arranging lifts, and only if you tick this.
rsvp.extras.heading: Almost done
rsvp.extras.intro: The optional bit, and then we're finished.
rsvp.field.songs: A song that will get you dancing?
rsvp.field.message: Anything you'd like to tell us?
rsvp.field.consentPrivacy: I'm happy for Mara & Terry to use this to plan the wedding.
rsvp.field.consentHealth: I'm happy for the food and allergy details to go to the caterer.
rsvp.field.consentSub: The caterer gets first names and meals only — no contact details.
rsvp.extras.privacyLink: What we do with your answers
rsvp.success.heading: You're on the list, {name}.
rsvp.success.noBody: Thank you for telling us — it genuinely helps. We'll raise a glass to you on the day.
rsvp.success.maybeBody: No pressure at all. We'll check back with you closer to the time.
rsvp.success.emailed: We've emailed your personal link to {email}. Keep that email — it's how you change your answer.
rsvp.success.duplicate: There was already a reply from this address, so we've reopened that one rather than starting a second.
rsvp.success.linkFallback: If the email doesn't arrive, this is your link:
rsvp.late.notice: We've passed our first deadline, but please still tell us — we'd much rather know.
rsvp.locked.heading: Numbers are with the caterer
rsvp.locked.body: The form has closed, but do get in touch if something has changed. We'll always try to make it work.
rsvp.edit.heading: Your answer
rsvp.edit.notFoundBody: It may have been mistyped, or the reply may have been removed. Ask us and we'll send a fresh one.
rsvp.edit.readOnly: The form has closed, so this is now read-only. Message us if anything has changed.

rsvp.find.heading: Find your answer
rsvp.find.body: Lost the email? Enter the address you replied with and your code, and we'll open your answer.
rsvp.find.codeHint: Six characters, like MT-4K9P2X. It's on the screen you saw after replying, and in your confirmation email.
rsvp.find.notFound: Those don't match anything we have. Check the code and the address — or just message us and we'll sort it out.
rsvp.gate.heading: The code from your invitation
rsvp.gate.body: There's a short code printed on your invitation. Pop it in and the form opens.
rsvp.gate.label: Code
rsvp.gate.wrong: That doesn't match — have another look at your invitation.
rsvp.gate.letThrough: We couldn't match that code, so we've opened the form anyway. Do fill it in — we'll just double-check with you later.
rsvp.gate.lost: Lost your invitation? Message us and we'll sort it out:
rsvp.success.partyCodeHint: Keep this one — we'll use it for seating and to find you when you arrive. It's in your email too.
rsvp.consent.heading: Your permission
rsvp.consent.intro: We need you to agree before we can record any of this. We only collect what we need to plan the day, we share nothing beyond the caterer and the hotel, and we delete all of it by {date}.
rsvp.langNote: Switching language reloads this page. Your answers are kept, but it is simplest to finish in one language.
imprint.title: Contact & imprint
imprint.intro: A private page with no company behind it. Here is who we are and how to reach us.
imprint.who: Mara and Terry, privately, for our own wedding. There is no company, no agency and nobody being paid.
imprint.contactBody: Email is the surest way, and it reaches both of us.
imprint.nature: A private, non-commercial invitation page for invited guests. Nothing is sold here, there is no advertising, and no money changes hands. Under German law a purely private site of this kind does not require a formal Impressum — this page exists so nobody has to wonder.
imprint.content: We write everything here ourselves and keep it as accurate as we can, but plans change. Times, prices and travel details may shift, so please check anything important with us. Where we link to other sites — the venue, hotels, the railway — those pages are theirs, not ours, and we cannot answer for what they say.
imprint.photos: The pictures of the two of us are our own. The pictures of the venue belong to the Grohnder Fährhaus and are shown here only so guests can see where they are going.
